name: Istoriya Fox'a
source:
This is the story of a 17-year-old reclusive student named Vladislav. One day, he ends up in the Sovyonok camp. What adventures await him there?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1501629077]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个17岁隐居学生弗拉迪斯拉夫的故事。有一天，他被关进了索维诺克集中营。那里有什么冒险等待着他呢？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1501629077]Steam[/url]]
